svg.title: Can later actions identify the same player?
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 | 598 outfield players | early basis frozen before 2018-01-01 Dot = mean; horizontal range = min-max over 3 NMF seeds, not a confidence interval. Dotted line = random rank-1 chance. Same club and at least 900 minutes in both periods. Ground attacking duels are observed take-on proxies, not inferred carries. This closed-set task measures on-ball style stability, not player ability or transfer success.
